main.title: I learn by building
main.text: What helped me most wasn't reading about a tool, but picking a real problem and solving it end to end: getting the data, cleaning it, modeling, validating, and presenting it so someone can actually use it. That's how I learned Python, Machine Learning, and most of what I use at work today.

principles.title: Process first, tool second
principles.description: Before automating, I cut the steps that don't need to be there.

principles.title: Validate before you show it
principles.description: I'd rather have an honest number than a pretty one; I document the errors I find.

principles.title: AI as a multiplier
principles.description: I use generative AI daily to design, code, and test faster, but the decisions and validation are mine.
